prompt:
被写体:
自宅の木床にひざまずき、白い布で床を拭く架空の成人日本人女性一人。日常の家事を丁寧に続ける自然なホームケア写真。

場所・時間・背景:
昼の明るい住宅内。茶色い木の床、壁際の木製食器棚、淡い壁、廊下へ続く奥行きを残し、生活感のある清潔な室内にする。

衣装・小物:
グレーの細いリブ編みノースリーブワンピース、前を開けたアイボリーのカーディガン。片手に白い柔らかな掃除布を持つ。

姿勢・手指・接触:
片膝を床につき、もう片方の膝を立てて上体を低く前へ傾ける。片手で布を床へ平らに当てて前方へ伸ばし、反対の手を腿へ置く。

表情・視線:
顔を床へ向け、拭いている場所を確認する穏やかな集中表情。レンズを見ず、家事の動作に注意を保つ。

顔・メイク:
自然な卵形輪郭、濃い茶色の瞳、整えすぎない眉、薄いベージュの目元、血色を抑えた頬と唇で日常的な清潔感を出す。

髪:
濃い茶色の髪を後ろで低くまとめ、前髪と頬の横へ細い後れ毛を落とす。前傾の動きに沿って一部の毛束を顔まわりへ寄せる。

光源:
室内の拡散昼光を主光にし、額、頬、肩、手、床面へ柔らかく当てる。木床の反射を弱い暖色の補助光として使う。

色・階調:
グレー、アイボリー、木の暖かな茶色、淡い壁色を低彩度でまとめる。中明度の自然な室内階調と健康的な肌色を保つ。

材質・微細質感:
ワンピースの細いリブ、カーディガンの編み、白い布の起毛、木床の板目とつや、食器棚の木材、髪の束を描き分ける。

構図・カメラ:
縦9:16の低めの近距離スナップ。胸の視覚中心を画面幅50%付近、伏せた顔中心を45%付近へ置き、頭部、胸元、立てた膝、伸ばした腕、布と床面を収める。

画像処理・仕上げ:
広角の生活感を残し、人物と布を明瞭に、奥の食器棚を軽くぼかす。木床の質感を過度に磨かず自然な住宅広告向け写真にする。

破綻回避・禁止:
成人女性一人、同じグレーのワンピース、カーディガン、白い布、木床、ひざまずく掃除姿勢を固定する。余分な指、変形した膝、濡れすぎた床、ロゴ、文字を加えない。

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
One fictional adult Japanese woman kneeling on a wooden floor at home, wiping the floor with a white cloth. A natural home-care photo depicting daily household chores being carried out meticulously.

Location / Time / Background:
Bright interior of a residence during the day. Brown wooden floor, a wooden cupboard along the wall, pale walls, preserving depth extending toward a hallway, creating a clean, lived-in interior.

Outfit / Accessories:
A gray fine-ribbed sleeveless dress, an open-front ivory cardigan. Holding a soft white cleaning cloth in one hand.

Pose / Hands & Fingers / Contact:
One knee resting on the floor, the other knee raised, leaning the upper body low and forward. Pressing the cloth flat against the floor with one hand and extending it forward, while resting the other hand on the thigh.

Expression / Gaze:
Face turned toward the floor with a calm, focused expression checking the spot being wiped. Not looking at the lens, keeping attention on the housekeeping movement.

Face / Makeup:
Natural oval face shape, dark brown eyes, unovergroomed eyebrows, light beige around the eyes, with subdued flush on the cheeks and lips to convey everyday cleanliness.

Hair:
Dark brown hair tied low in the back, with thin stray strands falling over the bangs and beside the cheeks. Some strands of hair drawn around the face following the forward-leaning motion.

Light Source:
Diffused daylight inside the room serves as the key light, softly illuminating the forehead, cheeks, shoulders, hands, and floor surface. The reflection from the wooden floor is used as a weak, warm fill light.

Color / Tones:
Coordinated in low saturation with gray, ivory, warm brown of wood, and pale wall colors. Maintaining natural mid-tone interior gradations and healthy skin tones.

Materials / Fine Textures:
Distinctly rendering the fine ribs of the dress, the knit of the cardigan, the nap of the white cloth, the grain and sheen of the wooden floor, the wood of the cupboard, and hair strands.

Composition / Camera:
Vertical 9:16 low-angle close-range snapshot. Visual center of the chest placed around 50% screen width, downcast face center placed around 45%, capturing the head, chest, raised knee, outstretched arm, cloth, and floor surface.

Image Processing / Finishing:
Preserving a wide-angle lived-in atmosphere, keeping the person and cloth sharp while softly blurring the cupboard in the background. Avoiding excessive polish on the wooden floor texture to produce a natural photo suitable for residential advertising.

Artifact Avoidance / Prohibitions:
Fixed to one adult woman, the same gray dress, cardigan, white cloth, wooden floor, and kneeling cleaning posture. Do not add extra fingers, deformed knees, overly wet floors, logos, or text.

translations.zh:
主体：
一名虚构的成年日本女性跪在家中的木地板上，用白布擦拭地板。自然展现细心操持日常家务的家庭生活写实摄影。

地点·时间·背景：
白天明亮的住宅室内。棕色木质地板、靠墙的木质碗柜、浅色墙壁，保留通向走廊的纵深感，营造富有生活气息且干净整洁的室内环境。

服装·配饰：
灰色细罗纹无袖连衣裙，敞穿米白色针织开衫。单手拿着一块柔软的白色清洁布。

姿势·手指·接触：
单膝着地，另一条腿立膝，上半身向前俯低。一手平按着抹布紧贴地板向前方伸展，另一手搭在腿上。

表情·视线：
脸朝向地板，平静而专注地查看擦拭位置的表情。不看镜头，注意力保持在家务动作上。

面部·妆容：
自然鹅蛋脸轮廓，深棕色瞳孔，不过分修饰的眉毛，淡米色眼妆，低血色感的脸颊与唇色，展现日常干净整洁感。

发型：
深棕色头发在脑后低低挽起，刘海和两颊散落细碎发丝。随着前倾动作，部分发束自然垂在脸庞周围。

光源：
以室内漫射日光为主光源，柔和地照在额头、面颊、肩膀、手部及地板表面。木地板的反光作为微弱暖色辅助光。

色彩·色调：
灰色、米白、木材的温暖棕色、淡色墙壁以低饱和度统一。保持中明度的自然室内色调与健康的肤色。

材质·细节质感：
细致刻画连衣裙的细罗纹、开衫的针织纹理、白布的绒毛感、木地板的木纹与光泽、碗柜的木材以及发丝的质感。

构图·机位：
9:16竖屏较低角度的近景抓拍。将胸口视觉中心置于画面横向50%附近，低下的面部中心置于45%附近，收录头部、胸口、立起的膝盖、伸出的手臂、抹布与地板表面。

后期处理·效果：
保留广角镜头带来的日常纪实感，人物与抹布清晰锐利，远处碗柜轻微虚化。不过度抛光木地板质感，呈现自然的住宅广告级摄影风。

防止失真·禁止项：
固定一位成年女性、同款灰色连衣裙、针织开衫、白布、木地板及跪地打扫姿势。不出现多余手指、变形的膝盖、过度湿润的地板、标志和文字。
translations.en:
Subject:
A single fictional adult Japanese woman kneeling on a wooden floor at home, wiping the floor with a white cloth. A natural home care photo capturing careful everyday housekeeping.

Location / Time / Background:
Bright interior of a home during the day. Brown wooden floor, a wooden cupboard against the wall, light-colored walls, retaining depth leading into a hallway, creating a clean room filled with a lived-in feel.

Outfit / Props:
A grey finely ribbed sleeveless dress, an open ivory cardigan. Holding a soft white cleaning cloth in one hand.

Pose / Fingers / Contact:
One knee on the floor, the other knee raised, leaning the upper body forward and low. One hand presses the cloth flat against the floor stretching forward, while the other rests on her thigh.

Expression / Gaze:
Face directed toward the floor, a calm and focused expression checking the spot being wiped. Not looking at the lens, staying attentive to the housework motion.

Face / Makeup:
Natural oval facial contour, dark brown eyes, gently groomed eyebrows, subtle beige around the eyes, understated color on cheeks and lips for a clean daily look.

Hair:
Dark brown hair gathered low in the back, with fine strands falling around the bangs and cheeks. Some locks drift naturally around the face with the forward-leaning movement.

Lighting:
Diffused indoor daylight as the primary light, softly striking the forehead, cheeks, shoulders, hands, and floor. Reflection from the wooden floor serves as gentle warm ambient fill light.

Color / Tonality:
Low-saturation coordination of grey, ivory, warm wood brown, and pale wall tones. Maintaining medium-brightness natural interior tones and healthy skin complexion.

Materials / Fine Textures:
Differentiating textures of the dress's fine ribs, cardigan knit, soft nap of the white cloth, wood grain and gloss of the floor, cupboard wood, and hair strands.

Composition / Camera:
Vertical 9:16 low close-up snapshot. Visual center of the chest near 50% screen width, lowered face center near 45%, capturing head, chest, raised knee, outstretched arm, cloth, and floor.

Processing / Finish:
Retaining a wide-angle lived-in atmosphere, keeping subject and cloth sharp with subtle background blur on the distant cabinet. Natural housing advertisement style without overly polished floor reflections.

Artifact Prevention / Negative:
Fixed single adult woman, identical grey dress, cardigan, white cloth, wooden floor, kneeling cleaning pose. No extra fingers, deformed knees, overly wet floor, logos, or text.
